first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public Devon County Council layer-669 listed-building feature payload for ListEntry 1222964, including returned physical Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry and the bound Name/Grade fields needed to evidence building identity/type. The official DCC layer metadata confirms an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer with ListEntry, Name, Grade, NGR and geometry fields, but the selected exact-record GeoJSON request was not retrievable through the web channel and direct network resolution failed before any feature payload was read; therefore no geometry or record attributes were inferred or fabricated and no individual building record was accepted.
